mapper.insert: insert into calender ( id, MEM_ID, PLACE, CAL_TEXT, TYPE_CD, SHARING_CD, STATE_CD, COLOR_TAG_CD, CAL_TYPE, CAL_START, CAL_END) values ( CAL_SEQ.nextval, #{memId}, #{place}, #{calText}, #{typeCd}, #{sharingCd}, '01STATE', #{colorTagCd}, #{calType}, #{calStart}, #{calEnd})
mapper.update: update calender set PLACE = #{place}, CAL_TEXT = #{calText}, SHARING_CD = #{sharingCd}, TYPE_CD = #{typeCd}, CAL_TYPE = #{calType}, CAL_START = #{calStart}, CAL_END = #{calEnd} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, CAL_TEXT AS calText, get_sub_code_name(CAL_TYPE) AS calType, get_sub_code_name(TYPE_CD) AS typeCd, CREATED_ON AS createdOn FROM CALENDER WHERE CREATED_ON > #{date}
SELECT ID AS id, CAL_TEXT AS calText, get_sub_code_name(CAL_TYPE) AS calType, get_sub_code_name(TYPE_CD) AS typeCd, CAL_START AS calStart FROM CALENDER WHERE CAL_START BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
